from pathlib import Path
progdir=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792484952/attempts/d113ac7d3c8446a89f045c03b3a31b6a/system/state/workspace/programs')
progdir.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # The three adjacent colors form a horizontal template. Extend the
    # middle color vertically; extend each outer color toward its template
    # column, then along that column to the corresponding template row.
    r = next(i for i,row in enumerate(grid) if sum(v != 0 for v in row) >= 3)
    cols = [j for j,v in enumerate(grid[r]) if v != 0]
    c0,c1,c2 = cols[:3]
    left,mid,right = (grid[r][c] for c in (c0,c1,c2))
    # Middle vertical ray
    for i in range(h):
        if out[i][c1] == 0: out[i][c1] = mid
    # Other same-color markers establish endpoints; connect via L paths.
    for color, tc in ((left,c0),(right,c2)):
        pts = [(i,j) for i,row in enumerate(grid) for j,v in enumerate(row) if v == color and not (i==r and j in (c0,c2))]
        if not pts: continue
        ar,ac = pts[0]
        for j in range(min(ac,tc), max(ac,tc)+1):
            if out[ar][j] == 0: out[ar][j] = color
        for i in range(min(ar,r), max(ar,r)+1):
            if out[i][tc] == 0: out[i][tc] = color
    return out
'''
p=progdir/'task-51effb6e.py'; p.write_text(code)
grid=[[0,0,0,4,8,5,0,0,0,0,0]]+[[0]*11 for _ in range(10)]
grid[7][0]=4; grid[9][10]=5
ns={}; exec(code,ns); result=ns['transform'](grid); print(result)
